tasks.gr12-paper1-mechanics-waves-electricity-: Topic: Paper 1 consolidation for mechanics, waves and electricity. Integrate momentum, projectile motion, work-energy-power, Doppler effect and electric circuits with internal resistance. Ask Grade 12 learners to select formulas quickly, interpret graphs and revise mixed calculation questions under exam conditions.
tasks.gr12-paper1-electrodynamics-optics-skill: Topic: Paper 1 electrodynamics and optical phenomena consolidation. Integrate generators, motors, electromagnetic induction, RMS values, the photoelectric effect, emission and absorption spectra, red shift and exam diagram interpretation. Ask Grade 12 learners to compare devices, explain photon ideas and solve short mixed revision items.
tasks.gr12-paper2-chemistry-integration-t4: Topic: Paper 2 chemistry consolidation. Integrate organic molecules and reactions, reaction rates, equilibrium, acids and bases, hydrolysis and electrochemical reactions. Ask Grade 12 learners to revise mixed chemistry concepts, identify reaction types, predict pH and explain electrochemical applications in exam style.
